title: anacardium excelsum
intro: Anacardium excelsum, commonly known as the cashew tree or cashew nut tree, is a tropical evergreen tree native to Brazil and parts of South America. The health benefits of Anacardium excelsum include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Anacardium excelsum include anacardic acids, cardol, and cardanol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
